flags.text: Tico Times reported that Costa Rica's Constitutional Chamber ordered a moratorium on tree-felling permits and suspended some construction authorizations in the Papagayo tourism zone in April 2026; developers asked for the measure to be lifted.

Tico Times reported in June 2026 that no trees had been cut and no construction had begun at Bahia Papagayo, and that a separate challenge to the 748-tree cutting permit was admitted by the Constitutional Chamber.

Tico Times, citing La Nacion, reported in August 2025 that the Santa Cruz Environmental Prosecutor opened an investigation into alleged illegal logging linked to the concession; the developer called the complaint unfounded.
